text: Dolgan (Дулҕан / һака тыла) Dolgan is a northern Turkic language spoken in the Taymyr Peninsula in the far north of the Russian Federation by about a thousand people. It is most closely related to Yakut (Sakha) and Dolgan is regarded by some as a dialect of Yakut.

text: The Dolgan people are a small Indigenous Turkic ethnic group of northern Siberia, primarily living in Siberia‘s Taymyr Peninsula and surrounding areas of Krasnoyarsk Krai and the Sakha Republic (also falsely known as Yakutia). Lifestyle: Traditionally nomadic or semi-nomadic, moving with reindeer herds across the tundra.
